panels.title: Missing data
panels.sql: WITH sources AS (SELECT 'builder_blog' AS step, 'Articles' AS label, 1 AS position UNION ALL SELECT 'ga4', 'Pageviews', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console', 'Search clicks and impressions', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'signups', 'Signups', 4), latest AS (SELECT step, status, started_at FROM (SELECT step, status, started_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE started_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ranked WHERE rn = 1), runs AS (SELECT COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) AS step, COALESCE(sources.label, latest.step) AS label, COALESCE(sources.position, 5) AS position, latest.status, latest.started_at FROM sources FULL JOIN latest ON latest.step = sources.step) SELECT severity, message FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('failed', 'cost_limited') THEN 'critical' WHEN status IS NULL OR status = 'not_configured' THEN 'warning' ELSE 'info' END AS severity, '**' || label || CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN ' haven''t been collected in the last 30 days' WHEN status = 'failed' THEN ' failed' WHEN status = 'cost_limited' THEN ' stopped at the cost cap' WHEN status = 'not_configured' THEN ' aren''t connected yet' WHEN status = 'running' THEN ' are collecting now' ELSE ' ' || status END || '**' || CASE WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step = 'search_console' THEN ': waiting for Search Console access.' WHEN status = 'not_configured' AND step = 'ga4' THEN ': waiting for a GA4 property.' WHEN status IS NULL OR status IN ('not_configured', 'running') THEN '.' ELSE ' on the ' || to_char(substr(started_at, 1, 10)::date, 'Mon FMDD') || ' run.' END AS message, position FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(status, '') <> 'succeeded' UNION ALL SELECT 'info', 'Nothing is missing: every source collected on its last run.', 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(status, '') <> 'succeeded') ) notices ORDER BY position

panels.title: Signups per day
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots) END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.signups FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

panels.title: Signups by author
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch_source') AS source_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT author, SUM(signups) AS signups FROM per_article GROUP BY author HAVING SUM(signups) > 0 ORDER BY signups DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Articles
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch_source') AS source_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT title, href, author, substr(published_at, 1, 10) AS published, signups, source_signups FROM per_article ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST, published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Signups per week by author
panels.sql: WITH top_authors AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) AND s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') HAVING SUM(s.value) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(s.value) DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, to_char(CURRENT_DATE - 1 - ((CURRENT_DATE - 1 - s.metric_date::date) / 7) * 7, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id JOIN top_authors t ON t.author = COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) AND s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY COALESCE(i.author, 'No author'), CURRENT_DATE - 1 - ((CURRENT_DATE - 1 - s.metric_date::date) / 7) * 7 ORDER BY MIN(s.metric_date), author

panels.title: Authors
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch_source') AS source_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT author{{?breakdown}}, {{breakdown}}{{/breakdown}}, COUNT(*) AS articles, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signups > 0) AS with_signups, SUM(signups) AS signups FROM per_article GROUP BY author{{?breakdown}}, {{breakdown}}{{/breakdown}} ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Articles
panels.sql: WITH per_article AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(i.author, 'No author') AS author, i.published_at, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch') AS signups, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'signups_first_touch_source') AS source_signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.author, i.published_at) SELECT title, href, author, signups FROM per_article ORDER BY signups DESC NULLS LAST, published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Signups per day, new and older articles
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots) END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE i.published_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS new_articles, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE i.published_at IS NULL OR i.published_at < to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS older FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.new_articles, totals.older FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE - 1 END ORDER BY dates.day

panels.title: New articles
panels.sql: SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date < to_char(substr(i.published_at, 1, 10)::date + 7, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_week, SUM(s.value) AS signups FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND substr(i.published_at, 1, 10)::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url, i.published_at ORDER BY i.published_at DESC

panels.title: Last 28 days against the 28 before
panels.sql: WITH windows AS (SELECT i.id, i.title, i.url AS href, COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 0) AS recent, COALESCE(SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric_date < to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')), 0) AS previous FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.metric = 'signups_first_touch' AND s.metric_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 56 AND s.metric_date::date < CURRENT_DATE WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.url) SELECT title, href, recent, previous, CASE WHEN previous > 0 THEN (recent - previous) * 100.0 / previous END AS change FROM windows WHERE recent + previous >= 10 ORDER BY recent - previous DESC

panels.title: Sources
panels.sql: WITH sources AS (SELECT 'builder_blog' AS step, 'Blog articles' AS label, 1 AS position UNION ALL SELECT 'ga4', 'GA4 pageviews', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'search_console', 'Search Console', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'signups', 'Signups', 4), latest AS (SELECT step, status, started_at, error_message FROM (SELECT step, status, started_at, error_message, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs WHERE started_at >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT COALESCE(sources.label, latest.step) AS source, CASE WHEN latest.status IS NULL THEN 'No run in 30 days' WHEN latest.status = 'succeeded' THEN 'Collected' WHEN latest.status = 'failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN latest.status = 'cost_limited' THEN 'Cost-limited' WHEN latest.status = 'not_configured' THEN 'Not set up' WHEN latest.status = 'running' THEN 'Running' ELSE latest.status END AS status, COALESCE(latest.started_at, (SELECT MAX(any_run.started_at) FROM analytics_content_collection_runs any_run WHERE any_run.step = sources.step)) AS last_run, (SELECT successful.window_end FROM analytics_content_collection_runs successful WHERE successful.step = COALESCE(sources.step, latest.step) AND successful.status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY successful.started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS data_through, latest.error_message AS detail FROM sources FULL JOIN latest ON latest.step = sources.step ORDER BY COALESCE(sources.position, 5), source
